which; specify the domain and range of each property.

courses.

rithm courses, if anything (justify your answer)? 2 P

Question 4. Modeling Knowledge with OWL/DL 5 P.
1. Express the following using the Description Logic syntax: 3 P.
a) EJ and VU are airlines. EJ oﬀers the ﬂights EJF1 and EJF2, while VU oﬀers
the ﬂight VUF3. The latter is a commercial ﬂight.
b) Flights are either charter ﬂights or commercial ﬂights (but not both)
c) Every airline oﬀers some ﬂight.
d) Commercial airlines are airlines that oﬀer only commercial ﬂights.
e) EJ oﬀers only commercial ﬂights.
f) Small airlines are airlines that oﬀer at most two ﬂights.
(Continues in the next page)
2. Which of the following assertions can you infer? 2 P.
a) EJ is a commercial airline
b) VU is a commercial airline
c) EJ and VU are small airlines.
d) EJF1 and EJF2 are commercial ﬂights.
Answer yes or no. If the answer is no, brieﬂy justify why.

build a countermodel.
